name: Lahmi
title: Goliath's Brother
summary: Lahmi was the brother of the famous Philistine giant Goliath from Gath. He was killed by Elhanan, son of Jair, in one of the battles between the Israelites and the Philistines during King David's reign. He is known as one of the Philistine giants who fell to David's mighty men.

keyEvents.title: Lahmi's Death in Battle Against the Israelites
keyEvents.description: Lahmi, brother of Goliath from Gath, was killed by Elhanan, son of Jair, in one of the battles against the Philistines. His spear shaft was like a weaver's beam, testifying to his enormous size.

keyEvents.title: War Against the Philistine Giants
keyEvents.description: Lahmi was one of several Philistine giants who fell in the battles between Israel and the Philistines during David's reign. These giants descended from Rapha in Gath.

keyEvents.title: Parallel Account in 2 Samuel
keyEvents.description: In the parallel account in 2 Samuel, Elhanan son of Jaare-Oregim from Bethlehem is mentioned as having killed a Philistine with a spear like a weaver's beam. This text has been subject to textual critical discussion.

keyEvents.title: The Philistine Giants Defeated
keyEvents.description: Lahmi's fall was part of a series of events in which several Philistine warriors from Gath were killed by David's mighty men, thereby strengthening Israel's military superiority over the Philistines.
